dataset: Severson processed features; train=41 cells, test1=43 separate cells
features: training segment vectors are means of 99 features over each consecutive 250-row window; test vectors use the first window only
design: same S=32; compare N=8 (4 segments/cell) vs N=32 (1 segment/cell); 20 random training-cell subsamples; test1 fixed
caveat: Pilot sampling scheme is a proxy for repeated segments; four file windows are temporal partitions of processed feature rows and are not asserted to be independent physical cycling protocols. Result is descriptive and does not establish that smaller N is generally preferable.
